Equal distance is not matched quality. Keep every failure.

visualReview.layout: Source, integrated054, JXLENC-051; native-scale center 384 by 384 crops, lossless PNG with no color conversion.
visualReview.findings: Text remains legible and detailed texture is similar, but JXLENC-051 introduces stronger block patterns in sunset gradients and pink color areas. Reject JXLENC-051 and its earlier JXLENC-041 policy despite aggregate matched-quality gains. Milder precision and adaptive DC smoothing require separate review.

retention: Milder DC precision retained for the Experimental opaque RGB8 sRGB writer above distance 1 at efforts 3/5/7. Other modes keep original precision. These small development curves do not qualify the full corpus. Full-size timing and decoding are a separate regression check; equal distance does not imply equal quality.

followupVisualReview.findings: Milder DC precision removes the strong added block patterns seen in JXLENC-051. Baseline ringing and texture loss remain visible. Additional adaptive DC smoothing shows no clear visual advantage and is not retained. Native-scale center crops do not establish a full-image visual pass.

runtime.policy: Seven alternating fresh-process core pairs on original 12 MP im26-1030, distance 3 effort 3, sole 3 GiB capped process tree. Inputs and source archive pinned. Different output quantization requires independent output verification; this is a runtime regression check, not equal-quality native comparison.
